notes.title: V1.11a is out! New Update Alert: Rats Infest the Arena!
notes.notes:
🚨 Prepare Your Weapons and Wits, Warriors of the Arena! 🚨

The ground trembles and the air thickens with foreboding as a new menace scurries into the heart of our beloved battlegrounds. Our latest game update brings an unprecedented challenge to the arena: hordes of pesky, cunning rats have infested our sacred combat grounds! These aren't your ordinary foes; they're clever, they're relentless, and they're hungry for victory.

🐀 What's New in the Update:

Rat Infestation: Brace yourselves for the newest adversaries to enter the arena. These aren't just any enemies; they're swarms of devious rats ready to test your skills and strategies. With unique abilities and unpredictable attack patterns, these creatures will require you to rethink your battle strategies and adapt like never before.

Save Game System Update: We've heard your feedback loud and clear! Enhancing your gaming experience is our top priority, so we're rolling out a significant update to our save game system. Expect smoother, more reliable save options, ensuring you can pick up right where you left off, no matter the chaos that ensues.

Minor Patches and Fixes: As always, we're dedicated to improving your gaming experience in every possible way. This update includes a series of minor patches and fixes, addressing known bugs and enhancing game stability. Expect improved performance, better balance, and a more polished experience overall.

🛡 Gear Up and Dive In!

The rats are cunning and innumerable, but we know our warriors are braver and stronger. This update is not just a test of strength but a call to strategy, resilience, and adaptability. Gather your allies, sharpen your weapons, and prepare for a battle like no other. Can you emerge victorious against the tides of whiskered warriors? There's only one way to find out.

🔥 Join the Battle Now!

This update is live, and the arena awaits your valor and strategy. Dive into the fray, face the horde, and carve your path to glory. Remember, in the heart of the arena, it's not just about fighting; it's about surviving, outsmarting, and overcoming.

See you in the arena, warriors. Let the battles begin!

Stay tuned for more updates and surprises along the way. We're just getting started, and we're thrilled to have you on this journey with us. Happy gaming, and may your blades strike true!

notes.title: Celebrating 3000 Players & New Update v0.5.057.1801
notes.notes:
Patch Notes - Rusalka Unreal Labs Games v0.5.057.1801

Greetings, Adventurers!

We are delighted to share a momentous achievement with our incredible community – over 3000 players have embarked on the enchanting journey within Rusalka Unreal Labs Games! Your unwavering support, enthusiasm, and dedication have propelled us to new heights, and we are immensely grateful for each and every one of you who has become part of this epic adventure.

As a token of our appreciation, we're thrilled to present the latest version of Chronicle Survivors Early Access - v0.5.057.1801, which introduces exciting new content and enhancements to elevate your gaming experience.

New Hero - Zarya, Shieldmaiden:

Joining the roster is Zarya, a formidable addition to your arsenal. Zarya comes equipped with two powerful abilities:

 Comet Rush: Dash forward, dealing 30 base damage to enemies and granting brief immunity for 1.5 seconds.
 Tower Shield: Activate a protective shield, rendering Zarya immune to damage for a moderate duration of 5 seconds.

New Auto Ability - Fire Ward:
Ignite your enemies with the Fire Ward auto ability, dealing consistent damage at regular intervals. Strategically deploy this power to overcome formidable foes. Zarya is base hero for this ability.

Balance Adjustments:
In response to your valuable feedback, we've made significant changes to enemy scaling. All opponents, including ghouls, now maintain their stats throughout the duration of a zone, providing a more consistent and challenging gameplay experience.

Optimized Save Games:
We've revamped the save game codes to ensure a seamless and secure gaming experience. Your progress within the Rusalka universe is now more reliable than ever.

Your collective passion has fueled the success of Rusalka Unreal Labs Games, and we're just getting started. Your feedback remains instrumental in shaping the future of our games, and we're committed to delivering more exciting updates in the coming weeks.

As we celebrate this remarkable milestone, we want to express our deepest gratitude to every adventurer who has contributed to the Rusalka Unreal Labs Games community. Your presence makes this journey truly extraordinary.

Stay tuned for more adventures and updates as we continue to explore the boundless possibilities of Rusalka. Thank you for being part of this incredible community.

Best regards,
The Rusalka Unreal Labs Team
